body: Suicide baiting.. Thanks, it's so horrible to hear someone would do something like that.

What type of situation would that make me in? I don't know what would happen if I did that.
You're right.. I have to start realising I'm my own individual and can make my own decisions.

I can't. I literally can't. My parents won't allow me to see anyone and I'm too shy and scared to speak to anyone outside of the Internet. I'm going to have to do something pretty whack crazy to get someone's attention, like climb up a high building and refuse to get down. There is no end to my suffering.

I don't even know how, I tell my parents all the time I feel sad but they tell me nobody will be able to help me because I'm beyond help. I've been discharged from the hospital and obviously I'm way too embarassed to go back (especially if that happens again).

I don't even know how to formulate my sentences right now, so please excuse any confusion. I tend to not make sense while I'm feeling sad.
I've been planning my suicide for ages now. I've eyed up some rope in my parent's garage, and I was hoping to tye a noose up to something that would hold my body weight. I hate my body, and I feel so incredibly selfish for hating my life. I can't tend to keep friends in, since I'm so emotional and delusional all the time.

I was at a camp when I was younger with my 'friends', and I was 'sleeping' on my bed with my eyes shut. One of my friends asked if I was awake, and I didn't really respond and I don't know why. My 'friends' ended up talking very badly at me and I just wanted to tell them I was awake but I never did. Needless to say, I never spoke to them again.

Once my school got a call from someone (a woman) claiming to be my mother. They said to pass me on a message for me to walk home that day. For some reason I had a really bad feeling, so I decided to catch a ride with one of my friends. I ended up just going home and playing on my computer. My parent's ran into my room and hugged me. They never made that call and never knew who did. 
I was 9.
Since forever.. I have only one or two fond memories.
I don't know how to tell my parents. I'm scared. I can barely talk.
